vibe: Trust, Growth, Calm. Institutional but warm and inviting, perfectly balancing the care for children and the elderly.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Since this acts as a kiosk app, touch targets must be massive.
spacing_and_layout.kiosk_layout: Split screen (50/50). Left side is an emotional image with a subtle gradient overlay. Right side is the check-in/out form with p-12 to p-20 padding.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_layout: The Control Room Grid (Bento Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6.
spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: Minimum h-16 for all inputs and buttons. Buttons should have p-6 or p-8.

cards.style: Neumorphism & Crisp. Flat background, 1px subtle border (#E5E7E2), soft shadow (shadow-sm). No heavy rounding, max rounded-xl.

buttons.primary: bg-[#4A7C59] text-white hover:bg-[#3B6347] transition-all hover:-translate-y-1 rounded-lg font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-[#C26D5C] text-white hover:bg-[#A35B4C] transition-all hover:-translate-y-1 rounded-lg font-medium
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-[#1F2924] border border-[#E5E7E2] hover:bg-[#F1F2F0] rounded-lg

inputs.style: h-16 text-xl rounded-lg border-[#E5E7E2] bg-[#FFFFFF] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#4A7C59] focus:border-transparent transition-all

header.style: Crystal Glass: bg-[#F9F8F6]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#E5E7E2]/50 z-50 sticky top-0

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons must lift (-translate-y-1) and cast a slightly larger shadow.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in and slide up for forms (Framer Motion: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}).
motion_and_interactions.focus_states: Inputs must have a visible ring-2 of the primary accent color. Accessibility is paramount.

icons.sizing: w-8 h-8 for kiosk buttons, w-5 h-5 for dashboard data.

media_urls.description: Elderly people enjoying a social gathering indoors.
Young children sitting at a table in a classroom.
Modern lounge area with contemporary furniture and large windows.

specific_instructions_to_main_agent: Create a toggle or selection at the start of Check-in to choose between 'Creche/Infantário' and 'Lar de Idosos'. Swap the hero image based on this selection.
Form inputs must be massive (h-16, text-lg or text-xl) since this will run on a tablet at a reception desk.
Dashboard MUST use a Bento Grid layout for statistics (visitors inside, average time, total today).
History table must support CSV Export.
Use Shadcn UI for forms, tables, dialogs, and toasts, but customize the paddings to match the 'Generous Spacing' philosophy.
For Kiosk pages (Entrada/Saída), do not use a standard navigation bar. Use a 'Crystal Glass' minimal header just showing the Institution Name and a subtle clock.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='btn-checkin-lar').
